title: Two Seconds at the Office Door
logline: A polite two-second gesture at a glass door costs a woman her career, and the viewer watches every link of the chain happen.

world.place: NORTHLINE, a present-day glass office building on a wet city street: its forecourt and badge-locked glass doors, the stone lobby with speed gates and lifts, an open-plan floor of cubicles, a training room; plus one dark private room across the city where the stolen files are sold.
world.time_span: Opens on a Friday at dusk (Maya walked out with her box), rewinds to the pouring Monday morning (rain_day outside and in the lobby, office_day upstairs), then that Monday night (office_night: the dark room and the ransacked office, where security pulls the lobby clip), back to Friday dusk, and finally a bright training-room morning some time later (office_day).
rules: present-day office life only: glass, steel, carpet tile, monitors, lanyards, keycards; no brand names except the invented NORTHLINE
never appears: weapons, police, a struggle, the thief's face in the dark room (the dark room is shown only in tight inserts)
every exterior wide shows the NORTHLINE glass doors and the card reader beside them; every lobby wide shows the doors, the speed gates and the corner security camera
the same CCTV frame (lobby camera, high in the north-west corner, looking at the doors) appears three times: live in the lobby, on the laptop security pulls, and on the training-room screen
world.palette_note: Maya owns the mustard cardigan; the stranger owns maroon (his tie) over charcoal; NORTHLINE teal is the company (sign, lanyards, reception panel); security navy is the guard; rain grey is Monday; charcoal is the night.

must_not_show.how: tight inserts only (the laptop and the monitor): the worked set is a deliberately small insert set with 29 objects and does not hold a wide

must_not_show.what: the stranger's face in close-up after he leaves the office
must_not_show.how: he is never seen again after the wave; the dark room has no one in it, only his bag

shots.vo_text: In 2019, a top-performing analyst named Maya got escorted out of her building by security. The whole disaster started because she held the office door for two seconds.
shots.purpose: Hook with the consequence: a stunned woman walked out of her own glass building with a box, then the door locked behind her; and plant the door as the thing that did it.
shots.action: Friday at dusk. The glass door swings shut behind Maya as she walks out onto the forecourt carrying a cardboard box of desk things against her chest, the guard a step behind at her right. She stops at box_spot. The guard turns, walks back inside to door_in, and turns the lock on the glass door. Maya turns to look back at the door through the glass; the reader lamp beside it shows red.

do.what: the lock of the glass door

views.shows: Maya, mustard cardigan, walking straight toward camera out of the glass doors with a cardboard box held against her chest (box at the bottom of frame, hands out of close view), the guard in navy a step behind her shoulder, the lit lobby behind the glass
views.why: the first second must show the woman and the event of the first clause already happening: she is being walked out, carrying her desk in a box

views.on: got escorted out of her building
views.shows: from low on the pavement, the camera cranes up past Maya and the guard standing small in front of the doors to the NORTHLINE sign and the glass tower above them; a street lamp edge in the foreground, dusk sky with lit windows
views.why: 'her building' and 'security' need the place: a big corporate tower, its locked glass front, and how small she is in front of it

views.shows: past Maya's right arm and the corner of her box (her shoulder a soft out-of-focus edge, never the back of her neck), through the glass door: the guard inside turning the lock; focus racks from her to his hand on the lock, then the camera pushes slowly onto the door handle with the red reader lamp beside it
views.why: the narrator names the cause, the door: the eye is led from her to the door that is now shut to her, and the shot ends on the handle she held
views.inside: the rack to the guard's hand lands on 'started'; the slow push to the handle and the red lamp carries 'she held the office door for two seconds'

shots.sound: dusk street: tyres on a damp road, a far siren-free city hum; the glass door thuds shut; the lock clacks; the reader beeps low (denied); her shoes on paving

shots.vo_text: It was a pouring Monday morning. Maya tapped her keycard, and a sharp-dressed guy juggling two hot coffees sprinted up behind her yelling, "Hold on, thanks!" Being polite, Maya flashed a smile and held the office door.
shots.purpose: The trigger: show the badge-locked door working for Maya, the plausible, charming stranger arriving, and the small kind act of holding the door, large and clear.
shots.action: Monday, pouring rain. Maya hurries along the wet pavement to the doors and taps her keycard on the reader: the lamp turns green and the lock clicks. Behind her, the stranger runs along the pavement from approach with a two-coffee carrier held up in one hand and his brown leather bag on his shoulder, calling out with his free hand raised. Maya pulls the right-hand glass door open, steps inside, turns, smiles and holds the door wide; he slips past her into the lobby with the coffees.

views.shows: the same street, now in pouring rain on a grey morning: the camera cranes down from above the parked cars to the forecourt as Maya hurries to the glass doors, rain streaking past the lens, the canopy dripping
views.why: the dissolve from Friday dusk to the same front in rain says 'earlier' without words: same place, a different day

views.shows: past Maya's arm (soft edge, no back of the neck): her keycard against the reader, the lamp flips from red to green; then the camera whips left down the pavement
views.why: the mechanism the story turns on: the door opens only for a badge. It must be seen working before it is bypassed

views.shows: the stranger in charcoal blazer and maroon tie running along the wet pavement toward the doors, a carrier of two coffees held high in one hand, a leather bag on his shoulder; planters and bollards slide past in the foreground
views.why: the man who changes everything, introduced as the narrator describes him: sharp suit, two coffees, hurrying, harmless-looking
views.inside: he runs from approach to just behind Maya; the camera tracks beside him and lets him arrive at the door on 'behind her'

views.shows: the stranger's face and raised free hand, coffees up, mouth open on 'Hold on, thanks!', rain on his shoulders; framed loose at the collar (the tie knot is out of frame or small)
views.why: a quoted line gets the face that says it, mouth moving, so the viewer hears it come from him

views.shows: Maya, inside the open glass door, turns, smiles and holds the leaf wide with one hand; the stranger slips past her with his coffees; the camera pushes in on her hand on the door handle and the green lamp beside it
views.why: the trigger itself, the two seconds of courtesy, must be large and readable; the push ends on the hand that holds the door
views.inside: her smile on 'flashed a smile'; he passes through on 'held the office door'; the push lands on her hand

shots.sound: heavy rain on paving and the canopy, drips, car tyres hissing; the reader beeps high and the lock clicks open; running shoes slapping puddles; coffee cups rattling in the carrier; the door hinge and the rain noise opening up

shots.vo_text: Only problem? He didn't work there—not even close. While Maya waited for the elevator,
shots.purpose: The turn: the man has no badge and walks straight past the gates, and the lobby camera sees it all, which is what will finish Maya.
shots.action: From the forecourt the camera follows the stranger through the door Maya holds (hold_door). Inside he walks past the speed gates beside her as she taps her badge at the middle gate; he carries no lanyard. He peels off left toward the office opening (to_office) while Maya walks to the lifts (lift_wait), presses the call button and waits facing the lift doors, her back to him.

views.shows: from the rainy forecourt behind the stranger, the camera passes through the open glass door, past Maya holding it, into the bright lobby
views.why: carries the viewer across the threshold with him: the exact moment the locked door stops mattering

views.shows: the stranger walking past the speed gates beside Maya, his chest bare of any lanyard while hers hangs teal; the camera tilts up from them to the security camera dome in the north-west corner
views.why: 'he didn't work there' needs proof: no badge; and the camera that will later convict her is introduced as the subject of the frame

views.on: While Maya waited for the elevator
views.shows: the security camera's own picture from high in the north-west corner (the set's cctv position and aim): Maya small at the lifts, back turned, and the stranger walking off toward the office opening with his coffees
views.why: shows where both are at once (she waits, he goes) and plants the exact framing that comes back as the evidence and on the training screen
views.still_reason: it is the fixed security camera's picture: its stillness is what makes it read as surveillance, and the same locked frame returns on the laptop security pulls in sh06 and on the training-room screen in sh08

shots.sound: the rain cut to a muffle as the door swings shut; lobby echo; the speed gate beeps and its flaps sigh open; footsteps on stone; the lift call chime; a faint electric hum on the CCTV view

shots.vo_text: he strolled past three cubicles and slid an unlocked laptop into his leather bag. He even waved at the front desk walking out. Nobody glanced up.
shots.purpose: The theft, done in plain sight: an easy stroll, one smooth movement into the bag, a friendly wave, and a whole floor that does not look up.
shots.action: The stranger strolls in by the west door and east along the first aisle past three workstations, coffees in one hand. At the victim's desk he sets the coffee carrier down, picks up the open laptop, closes it and slides it into his leather bag, flips the flap shut. He turns back the way he came, passes the front desk, where the receptionist stands on the phone looking at her screen, and waves to her; she lifts a hand without looking up. He leaves through the west door. worker_1 and worker_2 type at their desks the whole time, heads down.

views.shows: the stranger strolling left to right down the cubicle aisle, coffee carrier in hand, the camera travelling beside him as partitions, plants and chair backs slide past in the foreground and workers type behind
views.why: 'strolled past three cubicles': the ease of it, counted out by the partitions passing, and nobody turning

views.shows: from above the victim's desk: the open laptop with its unlocked desktop on screen; his hand closes it and the camera tilts down with it as it slides into the open brown leather bag and the flap drops
views.why: the theft is a small hand action: it must be big to be read, and the bag must be seen so it can be recognised in the dark room

views.on: He even waved at the front desk
views.shows: over the receptionist's shoulder as she talks on the phone looking down at her screen: the stranger, bag on his shoulder, gives her a cheery wave on his way to the door; she lifts a hand without looking; the camera pans with him to the open west door
views.why: the boldest moment of the theft, and the reason nobody stops him: he behaves like he belongs

views.shows: the whole floor from high in the south-west corner: rows of workers heads down at glowing monitors, the empty space on the victim's desk where the laptop was, the west door swinging shut
views.why: the result that changes the whole place is invisible: the geography says it, a full floor of people and not one head turned

shots.sound: office hum, keyboards clicking, a printer; footsteps on carpet; the laptop lid clicks shut, the leather flap slaps; the receptionist's murmured phone call; the door's soft close

shots.vo_text: Turns out that single laptop held private financial records for two hundred major clients. Before dinner, every file was up for auction
shots.purpose: The damage: the same laptop, in a dark room that night, full of client records, and those records for sale.
shots.action: Nobody is in the room. On the desk the stolen laptop is open, its screen a list of client folders; the stranger's brown leather bag lies open on the desk corner. On the monitor beside it an auction page shows the folders in rows with price tags that tick upward.

views.shows: in the dark, the brown leather bag sharp in the foreground; focus racks to the laptop beyond it, its screen glowing with rows of client folders under CLIENTS (200), and the camera pushes slowly toward the screen
views.why: 'that single laptop': the bag tells the viewer it is the same one; the screen shows what it held
views.inside: the rack from bag to laptop on 'that single laptop'; the push into the folder rows carries 'private financial records for two hundred major clients'

views.shows: the camera trucks right from the laptop to the monitor: the auction page, the same folders in neat rows, each with a price tag that ticks up
views.why: 'up for auction' must be seen as a listing with prices: the private files are now goods

shots.sound: a quiet room: the fan of the laptop, a router tick, distant traffic through the window; a soft digital blip each time a price ticks up

shots.vo_text: online—and fraud investigators were tearing the entire office apart. Security pulled one ten-second lobby clip,
shots.purpose: The consequence lands back where the theft happened: the same floor at night, turned over by investigators, and security finds the clip that names Maya.
shots.action: The office at night under the ceiling panels, the windows dark with city lights. Drawers hang open and papers cover the desks and carpet. investigator_1 pulls the drawers of the victim's desk and lifts out files; investigator_2 stands in the aisle reading a printout and points at the empty spot where the laptop was. The guard comes up the aisle with an open laptop (prop_laptop_open) and holds it out to them: on its screen plays the lobby CCTV frame of Maya holding the glass door while the stranger walks in.

do.to: the empty spot on the victim desk

do.what: the open laptop playing the lobby clip

views.shows: the same high wide of the floor as at noon, now at night: open drawers, papers on the carpet, investigator_1 yanking a drawer at the victim's desk, investigator_2 pointing at the empty spot where the laptop sat; the camera cranes down into the mess
views.why: reusing the noon framing shows the change: the floor nobody looked up from is now being torn apart, at the very desk the laptop came from
views.inside: the crane lands at desk height as 'tearing the entire office apart' is said, on the drawer coming out

views.on: Security pulled one ten-second lobby clip
views.shows: the laptop the guard holds out, filling the frame: the lobby CCTV frame (high, north-west corner) with a LOBBY CAM 2 timestamp, Maya holding the glass door wide and the stranger walking in past the reader; the camera pushes into the screen toward her hand on the door
views.why: the planted security camera pays off: the viewer recognises its frame, and the push picks out the one thing that damns her, her hand holding the door

shots.sound: night office hum; drawers ripped open, papers spilling, a filing cabinet slammed; two low voices; a laptop's tinny CCTV hum as the clip plays

shots.vo_text: and Maya's career vanished before Friday. No second chance, no severance—just a cardboard box. She'd literally just held the office door.
shots.purpose: Close the loop on the opening: back at Friday dusk, alone with her box in front of the locked door that she once held open.
shots.action: Friday at dusk, continuing sh01: the guard walks away inside the lobby, out of sight. Maya stands alone at box_spot holding the box against her chest. She looks down into it, then turns her head back toward the locked glass door.

views.shows: the camera cranes up and back from Maya standing alone on the forecourt with her box, the locked glass doors behind her and the guard walking away inside, until she is small under the tower in the dusk
views.why: 'her career vanished' is a woman getting smaller in front of the building that has shut her out

views.shows: looking down into the cardboard box: a mug, a small plant, a framed photo, a stapler and her teal lanyard lying on top; the camera arcs slowly around it, her hands out of the frame at the edges
views.why: 'just a cardboard box': the whole job reduced to a few objects, and the lanyard she no longer gets to wear

views.shows: Maya's face in three-quarter front as she turns to look back at the locked glass door, the door handle soft behind her; framed from the shoulders up with the collar at the bottom edge, a slow push in
views.why: the line repeats the trigger in its new context: her look back at the door is where the viewer feels the cost

shots.sound: dusk street, the city hum, a bus pulling away; the box's contents shift with a small clink; quiet

shots.vo_text: Even today, every single new hire watches her ten-second clip on orientation morning.
shots.purpose: The ending image: her two seconds have become a lesson, played on a big screen to rows of new hires.
shots.action: A bright orientation morning. The new hires sit in the tablet-arm chairs with new teal lanyards, watching the wall screen. The trainer stands by the lectern and points at the screen, where the CCTV clip of Maya holding the lobby door plays.

views.shows: from beside the screen, the front-row new hires' faces lit by it, new lanyards on their chests, eyes fixed past the camera; the camera trucks slowly along the row
views.why: 'every single new hire': the faces of the people who are being taught by her mistake, one after another

views.shows: from the back of the room over the hires' heads: the big wall screen playing the CCTV frame of Maya holding the lobby door, the trainer pointing at it; the camera pushes gently toward the screen and holds
views.why: the last line earns the last image: her two seconds on a screen, being watched, for good
views.inside: the push settles on the screen as 'orientation morning' ends, then the frame holds on the clip

shots.sound: a quiet bright room, a chair creak, the soft CCTV hum from the screen speakers; the music resolves on the hold

sound.delivery: upbeat and clear, a storyteller who knows the ending: brisk through the rain and the theft, slower and drier on the box and the last line
sound.music: light pulsing synth with a ticking motif for the Monday morning, dropping out to a low pad for the dark room, resolving softly on the training-room hold
sound.ambience: rain and city street outside, lobby echo, office hum, a quiet dark room, a bright training room
